move.subject: SH-220: revised price and delivery package
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your offer. Our line needs delivery within 35 days; your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet the requirement.
For 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months, please offer either €13.00 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; or €12.50 per unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, FCA.
Please confirm the achievable lead time and tell us which commercial option you prefer, including any constraint on freight or payment.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA.
Please let me explain.
We thank you for the volume projection of 6,000 shafts per year; to fully consider this, please provide a binding volume commitment or delivery schedules.
We confirm that we can accommodate the required 35-day lead time and prefer the 30-day payment terms under FCA delivery.
As the expedited production and FCA terms involve additional costs compared to our initial EXW offer, our revised price for this package is €17.00 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
